title: Naming supersession retry detects the superseded refusal by matching its message text
outcome: The naming's bounded re-prepare on a superseded authority image recognizes the supersession through a typed marker, not by comparing ApiError.message to ENGRAM_AUTHORITY_IMAGE_SUPERSEDED_ERROR, so a later message edit or a new site that reformats the text cannot silently turn the retry into an immediate refusal.
acceptance: prepare_engram_authority_retrying_supersession_until decides to retry from a typed superseded marker (an error variant or flag set by confirm_engram_authority_image_until at each place that raises the superseded refusal), never from the message text.
A regression changes the superseded message wording without touching the marker and the naming still retries and completes; the existing naming_supersede tests pass unchanged.
